# Cobalt2

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2)

Cobalt2 is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2 codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `cobalt2` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { cobalt2 } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-cobalt2';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, cobalt2],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `cobalt2` | `Extension` |
| `cobalt2MergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#193549` |
| Active line | `#203e52` |
| Selection | `#09478e` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#fea22f` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#fea22f` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#e1efff` | - | 10.93:1 | 9.61:1 | 7.81:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#e1efff` | - | 10.93:1 | 9.61:1 | 7.81:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#fff` | - | 12.75:1 | 11.22:1 | 9.12:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#fff` | - | 12.75:1 | 11.22:1 | 9.12:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#ffc600` | - | 8.09:1 | 7.12:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#9effff` | - | 11.05:1 | 9.72:1 | 7.90:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#fb99c8` | italic | 6.37:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#fb99c8` | italic | 6.37:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#fb99c8` | italic | 6.37:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.55:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a5ff90` | - | 10.51:1 | 9.24:1 | 7.51:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#a5ff90` | - | 10.51:1 | 9.24:1 | 7.51:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#fb9caf` | - | 6.36:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#fb9caf` | - | 6.36:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#fff` | - | 12.75:1 | 11.22:1 | 9.12:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#83bafe` | italic | 6.33:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#9effff` | - | 11.05:1 | 9.72:1 | 7.90:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#9effff` | - | 11.05:1 | 9.72:1 | 7.90:1 |

| Heading | `heading` | `#ffc600` | bold | 8.09:1 | 7.12:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#9effff` | italic | 11.05:1 | 9.72:1 | 7.90:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#ffffff` | background, active line, selection | 9.12:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#b7b7b7` | gutter | 6.89:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffc600` | background, active line | 7.12:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#80fcff` | background | 10.50:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #ffc60088` | background, active line | 3.10:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#CAD40F66, 1px solid #fea22f` | background (fill or outline) | 6.33:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#09478e` | active line | 1.23:1 | Pass |
